entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: PreNeg_Intro_1
entries.dialogueText: The heavy artillery had fallen eerily silent along the smoke-shrouded Zille frontier and across the Gulf of Moridia. Beside the battle maps in Palas Rezna lay urgent telegrams from Konstantium. Wiktor Smolak had dispatched an envoy under white flags proposing a face-to-face parley.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita_PreNeg_Report
entries.dialogueText: Your Majesty. A temporary ceasefire holds across Zille. Both armies have expended immense shells, and Smolak's delegation awaits at the neutral pavilion overlooking the peninsula.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento_PreNeg_HighLeverage
entries.dialogueText: The Alliance of Nations watches closely, Your Majesty—and thanks to the evidence, treaties, and diplomatic groundwork you assembled throughout this crisis, you enter that pavilion holding genuine leverage over Smolak.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo_PreNeg_Counsel
entries.dialogueText: Romus... Smolak shifts between buffoon and butcher in a heartbeat. Guard the dignity of House Toras, and never let him think our depots or treasury are weaker than they are.
entries.conditions: Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Arrested"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Executed"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Resigned"] ~= true

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Romus_PreNeg_Prompt
entries.dialogueText: I studied the final map positions, our separate casualty ledgers, and my leather briefcase before setting out for the border pavilion.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: PreNeg_Check_Ledger
entries.dialogueText: Give me the exact numbers: how do our Zille losses compare separately from Pales, and can our treasury and arsenals back an ultimatum if Smolak walks out?
entries.menuText: "Brief me on our exact Zille losses, any Pales drain, and whether our depots could sustain renewed fighting."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: PreNeg_Check_Leverage
entries.dialogueText: List every piece of leverage we hold against Wiktor Smolak right now—treaties, intelligence dossiers, foreign pacts, and blockades.
entries.menuText: "List every diplomatic card we hold against Smolak inside that briefcase."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Choice_Parley_Strength
entries.dialogueText: Prepare the royal armored motorcade. I will meet Smolak under the royal standard and dictate or bargain cleanly.
entries.menuText: "Prepare the royal motorcade. I will meet Smolak and play our cards face to face."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Choice_Unconditional_Surrender
entries.dialogueText: Inform Smolak that if he stalls in that pavilion, our batteries and ships reopen fire within the hour. We bargain from unmistakable steel.
entries.menuText: "Tell Smolak our guns stay loaded—with full depots behind us, stalling means renewed bombardment!"
entries.conditions: ((Variable["Zille_War_Outcome"] or 0) >= 3 or (Variable["Zille_War_Outcome"] or 0) == 0) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Military_Equipment"] or 0) >= 1000 or (Variable["Zille_Leverage"] or 0) >= 2 and (Variable["Zille_Leverage"] or 0) < 4)
entries.userScript: Variable["Zille_Parley_Ready"] = true; Variable["Zille_Parley_Uncompromising"] = true; Variable["Zille_Smolak_Pressure"] = (Variable["Zille_Smolak_Pressure"] or 0) + 2; Variable["Zille_Leverage"] = (Variable["Zille_Leverage"] or 0) + 1;

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Ack_PreNeg_Lucita
entries.dialogueText: Lucita strapped on her sidearm and saluted with iron resolve. "The royal escort is mounted, Your Majesty. Let us bring Zille home."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos_PreNeg_Report
entries.dialogueText: Your Majesty. Both fronts stand in a fragile truce. Our generals tally our exact Zille losses separately from any eastern Pales casualties as Smolak awaits your arrival at the pavilion.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento_PreNeg_LowLeverage
entries.dialogueText: The Alliance of Nations presses for settlement, Your Majesty. Because our diplomatic leverage remains limited, what you salvage or dictate across that table will depend almost entirely on what our soldiers presently hold on the ground.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento_PreNeg_NoHugo
entries.dialogueText: Remember Smolak's nature, Your Majesty—he alternates between clownish jokes and vicious blackmail. Keep your cards close to your chest.
entries.conditions: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Arrested"] == true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Executed"] == true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Resigned"] == true)

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Ack_PreNeg_Strong
entries.dialogueText: "Our separate Zille casualty ledger stays manageable, and with over 1,000 weapons in stock and healthy treasury reserves, Smolak knows we are not bluffing if talks collapse."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Ack_PreNeg_Thin
entries.dialogueText: "Keep a calm face in the pavilion, Your Majesty: whether from fierce Zille attrition, Pales draining our reserves, or depots sitting under 1,000 weapons, renewed all-out combat would strain our treasury severely. Use diplomacy and leverage ruthlessly."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Ack_PreNeg_Leverage
entries.dialogueText: "Your case rests on the lapsed 1927 agreement, any Zille bombing intelligence you preserved, naval pressure across the Gulf of Moridia, and whatever pacts you sealed with Naeal, Perla, or Thornbourgh. Strike him with whichever weakness cuts deepest first."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Ack_PreNeg_Carlos
entries.dialogueText: General Carlos Azaro snapped a crisp salute. "The armored escort is ready, Your Majesty."
